title: 第3685章 又是巅峰主宰他知道我们会来第3684章 踢铁板了我就就开个玩笑
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
叶凌当然不可能真的对鬼族手下留情，只是眼前的独眼鬼族留着比直接杀掉稍微有用一点。
时隔千万年之久，白娅所知道的白虎圣地的情况，现在或许早就已经发生了翻天覆地的变化。
现如今的白虎圣地，可不再是千万年前的白虎圣地。
通过这个独眼鬼族的灵魂，也能了解到目前白虎圣地的具体情况。
都已经准备好赴死，闭着眼睛的独眼鬼族，自然也听到了叶凌的话。
猛地睁开眼睛，独眼鬼族的目光瞬间落在叶凌身上。
人族！
他不知道眼前这个男人为什么会留下自己，但总感觉没好事。
可若是有机会活下去，谁又愿意赴死呢？
就在独眼鬼族露出一丝庆幸，以为自己能活下去的表情时，叶凌直接召唤出阿雅。
身穿一身白色旗袍，戴着金丝眼镜的阿雅出现在花虞身边。
轻轻扶了一下眼镜，阿雅将手轻轻搭在叶凌的肩上。
“主人，突然召唤我出来，有什么事吗？”
“阿雅，我要知道白虎圣地内的一切情况，这家伙就交给你处置了。”
叶凌随手指向独眼鬼族，仿佛那只是一样任人处置的东西。
被当面无视，独眼鬼族心中自然不服气。
可不服气又能怎么样？他可没有办法对付白娅。
而这个刚刚被那男人召唤出来的女人，身上散发出来的气息同样恐怖。
又是一个巅峰主宰！
什么时候在白虎圣地外，有这么多巅峰主宰存在了？

巅峰主宰哪怕是在白虎圣地，也都是十分少有的超级强者。
而在白虎圣地外，也不说完全没可能有巅峰主宰存在，但绝对不至于有这么多才是。
随随便便就召唤出了两名巅峰主宰，眼前这人到底是谁？
从没听说过人族有这等厉害的强者。
他在白虎圣地的鬼族内，也算老一辈了，自然知道人族的情况。
人族有不少巅峰主宰强者，其中最为强大的就是人族最强者——空。
在这些巅峰主宰强者中，却并没有和眼前这个人相匹配的特征。
因此可以确定，眼前这个人族男性，绝不是白虎圣地人族中的巅峰主宰强者。
阿雅的目光落在独眼鬼族身上，眼镜上泛起一丝丝寒光。
突然间被阿雅凝视，独眼鬼族骤然感觉到后脊发凉。
总感觉会有不好的事情发生！
“没问题，主人放心，只是一点小事。”
说着，阿雅向前迈出一步，瞬间出现在独眼鬼族身后。
她手中不知何时，出现了一把看上去很是精巧的折扇。
合拢的折扇抵在独眼鬼族的头顶，阿雅眼中泛起了灰色的微光。
“呃——！！”
正感到疑惑的独眼鬼族，突然感觉到一股莫名的吸力，正在疯狂拉扯自己的灵魂。
“这是……？！”
他好歹也是老一辈的鬼族主宰，自然是见多识广。
content_en:
Of course, Ye Ling couldn't really show mercy to the ghosts, but keeping the one-eyed ghosts in front of him was slightly more useful than killing them directly.
After tens of millions of years, the situation in the White Tiger Holy Land that Bai Ya knew may have undergone earth-shaking changes.
The White Tiger Holy Land today is no longer the White Tiger Holy Land tens of millions of years ago.
Through the soul of this one-eyed ghost clan, we can also understand the current specific situation of the White Tiger Holy Land.
The one-eyed ghost clan, who were all ready to die with their eyes closed, naturally heard Ye Ling's words.
Opening his eyes suddenly, the one-eyed ghost clan's gaze instantly fell on Ye Ling.
Human race!
He didn't know why the man in front of him left him behind, but he always felt that something was wrong.
But if there is a chance to live, who would be willing to die?
Just when the one-eyed ghost tribe showed a hint of joy that they thought they could survive, Ye Ling directly summoned Aya.
Aya, wearing a white cheongsam and gold-rimmed glasses, appeared next to Hua Yu.
After adjusting her glasses slightly, Aya gently put her hand on Ye Ling's shoulder.
"Master, you summoned me suddenly. What's the matter?"
"Aya, if I want to know everything going on in the White Tiger Holy Land, I will leave this guy to your disposal."
Ye Ling casually pointed at the one-eyed ghost clan, as if they were just something that could be manipulated by others.
Being ignored in person, the one-eyed ghost tribe was naturally unconvinced.
But what if you are not convinced? He had no way to deal with Bai Ya.
And the aura exuding from the woman who had just been summoned by the man was equally terrifying.
Another pinnacle master!
When did so many peak masters exist outside the White Tiger Holy Land?
Even in the White Tiger Holy Land, the peak master is a very rare super power.
Outside the White Tiger Holy Land, it is not said that it is impossible for peak masters to exist, but there are definitely not so many.
Two peak masters were summoned casually. Who are these people in front of them?
I have never heard of such a powerful person in the human race.
He is considered an older generation among the ghost tribe in the White Tiger Holy Land, so he naturally knows the situation of the human race.
There are many peak masters in the human race, and the most powerful among them is the strongest in the human race - Kong.
Among these peak masters, there is no characteristic that matches the person in front of him.
Therefore, it can be determined that the human male in front of him is by no means the peak dominant power among the humans in the White Tiger Holy Land.
Aya's eyes fell on the one-eyed ghost clan, and there was a hint of cold light on her glasses.
Suddenly being stared at by Aya, the one-eyed ghost tribe suddenly felt a chill running down their spine.
There is always a feeling that something bad will happen!
"No problem, don't worry, Master, it's just a small matter."
With that said, Aya took a step forward and instantly appeared behind the one-eyed ghost clan.
At some point, a very delicate-looking folding fan appeared in her hand.
The closed folding fan was pressed against the head of the one-eyed ghost tribe, and Aya's eyes glowed with a gray glimmer.
"Uh-!!"
The one-eyed ghost tribe who was feeling confused suddenly felt an inexplicable suction force, which was pulling at his soul crazily.
"This is...?!"
After all, he is also the leader of the ghost clan of the older generation, so he is naturally well-informed.
